tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal sa skya pa'i bka' bsrung rnams kyi gtor chog rgyun gyi nyams len shin tu gsal ba'i phyag len ma 'bring po bzhugs so// na maḥshrī tsakra nā tha ā nan+da pu ṇ+ya ya/ dbang thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa'i bsgrub pa pos yi dam chos skyong la gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod pas/ gnas khang yid du 'ong bar yi dam chos skyong sogs kyi bris sku yod na zhal shar ram lhor phyogs par dgram/ de'i mdun du stegs bu ji ltar rigs par ras la sogs pas bkab pa'i steng du/ 'bru sna tshogs bcal du bkram/ de'i steng du 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma zlum po gnyis/ bshos bu gru bzhi rnams/ dmigs sha ma yin pa'i sha la sogs pa rgyan sna tshogs kyi brgyan pa dang / mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga rnams gtsang zhing bkod pa mdzes par bshams/ rnal 'byor pa'i mdun du rdo rje dril bu/ nang mchod la sogs pa nyer bar mkho ba'i yo byad rnams kyang ma tshang ba med par bkod/ gtor ma nang mchod chu chang gi sbyangs la lha'i rnal 'byor sngon du 'gro bas/ rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor te/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarbā dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu gdungs pa lta bu ba dan gyi mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ā las thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa dpral ba rang la bstan pa'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ go ku da ha na las sha lnga/ sha de rnams re re'i steng du yang / bh+rūṃ/ aṃ/ dz+rīṃ/ khaṃ/ hūm̐ las bdud rtsi lnga/ de dag gi steng du ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gyi rigs lnga'i sa bon gyis mtshan pa/ zla ba'i mthar g.yon bskor gyi a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/

e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ g.yas bskor gyis/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa dha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ de rnams kyi steng gi nam mkha' la oṃ dkar po mgo 'thur du bltas pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gi mtshan pa/ rdo rje lte ba'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pa rlung gi ba dan la phog pas/ rlung g.yos me sbar bas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga rnams skol zhing 'od du zhu ba'i rlangs pa gyen la song bas/ oṃ dang rdo rje lte ba'i hūm̐ la phog pas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzags/ yang hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rnams he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par byon te/ rdo rje lte ba'i hūm̐ la thim pas rdo rje brjid dang ldan par gyur/ rdo rje nyi ma oṃ dang bcas pa thod pa'i nang du lhung ba 'od du zhu nas sngar gyi bdud rtsi rnams dang gnyis su med par gyur te/ kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa'i bdud rtsi rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum dang / bya khyung gi phyag rgya sogs 'og bzhin bstan la byin rlabs nas/ gtor ma'i steng gi nam mkhar e e e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum gsum brtsegs kyi nang du paṃ paṃ paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa re re/ steng gi chos 'byung la gnas pa'i pad+ma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la oṃ dgu yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su sku rdo rje/ shar du dbang phyug chen po/ lhor lha'i dbang po/ nub tu tshangs pa/ byang du khyab 'jug shar lhor 'dod pa'i rgyal po/ lho nub tu tshogs kyi bdag po/ nub byang du bh+rīṃ gi ri ti/ byang shar du gzhon nu kirti ka ste thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang 'dra'i rig ma la 'khyud pa/

bar gyi chos 'byung la gnas pa'i pad+ma'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ aṃ gaṃ tsaṃ baṃ ghaṃ paṃ shaṃ laṃ ḍaṃ las bcom ldan 'das snying po kye rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor/ 'dab ma brgyad la hūm̐ brgyad yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du brgya byin/ lhor gshin rje/ nub tu chu lha/ byang du gnod sbyin/ shar lhor me lha/ lho nub tu srin po/ nub byang du rlung lha/ byang shar du dbang ldan te thams cad kyang sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa rang 'dra'i rig ma la 'khyud pa/ 'og gi chos 'byung la gnas pa'i pad+ma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la āḥdagu yongs su gyur pa las dbus su gsung rdo rje/ shar stobs kyi rgyu/ lhor dung skyong / nub tu mtha' yas/ byang du nor rgyas/ shar lhor 'jog po/ lho nub tu rigs ldan/ nub byang du pad+ma/ byang shar du pad+ma chen po ste thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang 'dra'i rig ma la 'khyud pa/ 'byung po nyer bzhi po 'di dag thams cad pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyi bzhugs pa/ rus pa'i rgyan gyi brgyan pa/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas steng gi lha thams cad lha chen brgyad la thim/ sa steng na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad phyogs skyong brgyad la thim/ sa 'og na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad klu chen brgyad la thim/ de thams cad kyi mi tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje ma/ sna la ser sna rdo rje ma/ kha la 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ lus la phrag dog rdo rje ma/ yid la bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ spyi bor sku rdo rje ma/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje ma/ thugs khar thugs rdo rje ma/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kye rdo rje lha dgu sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i lha tshogs dang bcas pa'i rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

zhes dang / se gol gyi sgras spyan drangs/ so so'i phyag rgya bcas te/ oṃ badz+ra gau rī ā kar ṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra tsau rī pra be sha ya hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra bet+ta lī ban+dha baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rī wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ slar yang snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ thal mo sbyar te/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin/ /chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod/ /ro lang ma ni chu lag ma/ /sgasma rī ni sman 'dzin zhing / /puk+ka sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin/ /gdol pa mo ni cang te'u brdung / /'di rnams kyis ni gtso bo mchod/ /'dod chags chen pos rjes chags pas/ /g.yung mo'i sku la 'khyud pa nyid/ /bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid can rnams kyi/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi/ /khams gsum kun gyi phyag byas pa/ /rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ /oṃ badz+ri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ sku rdo rje lha chen brgyad dang bcas pa la rnam par snang mdzad/ gtso bo yab yum gnyis gau rī dang puk+ka sī la mi bskyod pa/ tsau rī dang sha wa ri la rnam par snang mdzad/ bait+ta lī dang tsaṇ+ḍa lī la rin chen 'byung ldan/ ghasma rī dang ḍom+bhi nī la 'od dpag med/ phyogs skyong brgyad la mi bskyod pa/ gsung rdo rje klu chen brgyad dang bcas pa la 'od dpag med pa'i dbu brgyan/ oṃ bha ga wan mahā ka ru ṇi ka he badz+ra sa pa ri wa ra oṃ ni rī hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra ni wi te hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ne swāhā/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ khaṃ raṃ ma hā ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha swāhā/ zhes pa rnams phyag rgya dang bcas pas chu bzhi phul/ lha rnams kyi ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje nas 'bras tsam gyis mtshan pa las 'od kyi sbu gu byung nas gtor ma drangs te gsol bar bsam zhing /

pad skor sngon du 'gro bas/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ bha ga wan mahā ka ru ṇi ka he badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra/ oṃ in+da/ dza ma/ dza la/ dzak+kha bhu ta/ ba hin/ bā u/ rak+kha/ tsan+da/ sudz+dza/ mā da/ paspa ta la/ pā ta le/ aṣ+ṭa/ sap+pa/ swāhā/ i daṃ ba liṃ bhuñja/ dzi gha phul la/ dhū pa/ maṃ sa/ pi gha/ em+bha/ sap+pa/ kādz+dza/ sā dhā/ khin+ta/ khu ṇi/ phe ḍa gā ra/ oṃ a ka ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇaṃ/ ad+ya nut+pan+nā trad oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes brjod cing se gol gdab/ de ltar lan gsum gyi gtor ma phul/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du thog mtha' 'dra bar sbyar la/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shap+ta zhes pas phyi mchod/ hūm̐ aṃ gaṃ tsaṃ baṃ ghaṃ paṃ laṃ ḍaṃ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ kye rdo rje lha dgu sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i lha tshogs dang bcas pa'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /zhes dang / mtheb srin gyi gtor mas nang mchod phul la/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i thal mo dang / dril bu gsum brdungs bya zhing / dkar mo ri dwags sogs nas/ 'khyud pa nyid ces pa'i bar dang / khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor/ /khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyi mchog brnyes pa/ /khyod kyi rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'gro ba kun brgyan te/ /snying rje'i thugs kyis sems can bsad mdzad pa/ /sgyu ma'i spros pa rdo rje bsgrub pa yi/ /he ru ka dpal rdo rje yid kyi dgyes/ /mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkhas chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po/ /rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal mchog /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med/ /rang bzhin dag pas dgos pa med/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/

/rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ /mi rtog rdo rje nam mkha' 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /pad+ma mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /dngos nyid dag pa nyid las byung / /sna tshogs mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /zhes pas bstod/ rdo rje thugs gar bzung / dril bu chig brdung bya zhing / lha chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /'jig rten skyongs ba brgyad po dang / /gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /srin po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /'byung po'i༞ yi dwags༞ sha za'i༞ smyo byed༞ brjed byed༞ mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /de la sogs te 'byung po'i tshogs/ /ma lus ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang / /long spyod rgya chen kun thob cing / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyi bdag la bsrung / /dngos grub kun gyi stong grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang / /dge legs thams cad 'byung ba dang / /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces pas 'phrin las gzhol/ de nas gtor ma gnyis pa la byin rlabs sngar dus gcig la grub zin yang / byin rlabs dran pa'i phyir gtor ma lag pa g.yon pa bstan te/ oṃ zhes brjod pas stong par bsam/ g.yas bstan te āḥzhes brjod pas thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba/ dpral ba rang la bstan pa/ gnyis ka bstan te/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas gang ba/

bya khyung gi phyag rgya bstan te hoḥzhes brjod ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur par bsam la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su paṃ las pad+ma dang / raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mi ro dmar ser mgo bo g.yas su bstan pa'i steng du rdo rje gri gug sngo nag gi yu ba la hūm̐ mthing nag gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje nag po chen po cher 'bar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas gri gug dang / g.yon thod pa khrag gi gang ba thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ phyag gnyis char gyi dbus su rnam 'phrul gser gyi gaṇ+ḍe bsnams pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal mche ba brtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang sbrul gyi brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ dar sna tshogs kyi cod paṇa dang lhab lhub kyis klub pa/ mi'u thung gel ba'i 'dug stangs kyis ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas na bya nag g.yon na khyi nag rgyab na ce spyang / mdun na mi nag steng na nam mkha' lding gi sprul pa'i pho nya 'phro ba/ mi bskyod pa'i cod paṇa can ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yon du traṃ las e ka dza ti sku mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi bdud rtsi'i gang ba'i bum pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ dar dkar gyi na bzas stod g.yogs shing / stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ ral pa lan bu gcig tu gyur pa g.yon du 'phyang ba khro mo'i rnam pa can/ de'i lto ba yangs pa'i nang du/ traka las khrag gi rgya mtsho'i nang du/ bh+yo las dpal ldan lho mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ bong bu gwa pa la zhon pa/ sku mdog sngo nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas kyi dang po na ral gri/ gnyis pa na thod pa khrag gi gang ba 'dzin pa/

g.yon gyi dang po na mdung / gnyis pa na rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ glang po che'i ko bas stod g.yogs shing / ba glang gi go bas smad g.yogs pa/ re lde'i sham thabs can/ klu'i dbang po'i ske rags bcings pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing / mi ro rengs pa khar bcug nas mche ba gtsigs pa/ snyan g.yas pa la dug sbrul dang / g.yon pa la seṅges brgyan pa/ sku la khrag gi thig le dang / zhag gi zo ris dang / thal chen gyi tshom bu bkod pa/ shin tu rid pa lte ba'i thad ka nas nyi zla 'char ba/ ma mo mkha' 'gro sha za 'bum sde'i dbus na hūm̐ dang bh+yo'i sgra sgrogs pa/ mgon po'i g.yas su pad+ma nyi ma mi ro'i steng du rdo rje gri gug sngo nag gi yu ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa/ phyag bzhi pa/ zhabs gnyis pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal nag po ro za ba/ steng zhal dud kha mche ba rab tu gtsigs pa/ g.yas g.yon gnyis ljang nag zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po na gri gug g.yon dang po na thod pa khrag gi gang ba thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ g.yas 'og ma la gri 'phyar thabs/ g.yon 'og ma rus phreng / chang gi bkang ba'i bum pa mchan khung du 'dzin pa/ thod pa skam po lngas dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang sbrul gyi brgyan pa/ tshangs pa'i skud pa'i se ral kha dang / stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yas bskum/ g.yon bskyangs pas ro'i steng na gar stabs kyi bzhugs pa/ drag la rngam pa'i cha lugs can/ ngag tu hā hā dang / hūm̐ hūm̐ dang k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ gi sgra sgrogs pa/ de'i g.yas su g.yung mo nag mo/ g.yon du gtum mo ljang gu/ mdun du sring mo dmar mo/

rgyab tu sing ga li ser nag bzhi ka'ang zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ gcer bu rgyan cha med pa rab tu grim zhing khros pa'i cha lugs can/ g.yon brkyang g.yas bskum bzhengs pa'i tshul gyi ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ mgon po'i thugs ka nas ya/ lha mo'i thugs ka nas mam mdun du spros pa las nag po gnod sbyin sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas lcags kyi gri gug g.yon par ba gdengs pa'i mthil du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa/ dar nag gi na bza' dang / mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi gyon pa/ maṃ las nag mo gnod sbyin g.yas gser gyi spu gri dang / g.yon par ba gdengs pa'i mthil na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa/ byi ru'i lan tshar bcas/ yab las triḥtriḥ yum las bh+yoḥspros pa las/ pu tra ming sring gsum du gyur te/ triḥlas las kyi mgon po pu tra nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas lcags kyi ral gri dang / g.yon thod pa khrag gi gang ba 'dzin pa/ dar gyi aṅga raka dang / dar nag gi na bzas brgyan pa/ tri las bha ṭa nag po stag klog can/ g.yas gsher shing gi dam shing dang / g.yon mi'i snying rlon pa 'dzin pa/ bh+yoḥlas sring mo khrag mig ma kha nas me 'bar ba phyag g.yas spu gri/ g.yon mi'i rgyu ma 'dzin zhing / za 'og na tri'i gos gyon pa/ lnga ka'ang sku mdog nag po rab tu khros pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbu rgyan dang / rgyu ma la brgyus pa'i rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa'i do shal can/ gzhan yang g.yas kyi ru 'dren pa skyes pa stag chas brgyan pa brgya/ g.yon gyi ru 'dren pa dge slong mkhar gsil thogs pa brgya/ slad kyi rjes 'brang sngags nag ban phur thogs pa brgya/ mdun gyi shugs phyang 'dren pa bud med nag mo par ba gdengs pa brgya/ gzhan yang dam nyams kyi rjes gcod pa'i bya nag khyi nag ce spyang / mi nag la sogs pa'i pho nya bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/

mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i dbus su nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ bh+yoḥhūm̐ yaṃ maṃḥtriḥtriḥbh+yoḥ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros 'og min rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs ka nas mgon po dang / sum cu rtsa gsum de wi ko ta sogs nas lha mo/ ti se/ bsil ba'i tshal/ po tā la/ hā hā rgod pa'i dur khrod/ dar lung gnyan gyi pho brang / kha'us brag rdzong / dpal ldan sa skya'i gtsug lag khang nas/ dpal gdong bzhi pa/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas las kyi mgon po pho nya 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ mgon po kun gshegs gdan la bzhengs/ /da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus/ /gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i gnas ngan yang / /shākya'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang / /bdag cag rnams la phan btags phyir/ /gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol/ /lha mo kun gshegs sogs yab dang 'gre/ hūm̐ sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru/ /gtum po khyod kyi ji ltar khas blang ltar/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag las la spyan 'dren gyis/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol/ /las mgon kun gshegs gdan las bzhengs/ /sogs lcam dral gzhan rigs 'dre/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la ya/ mahā kā li de wi/ mahā kā la tsa turmu kha sa pa ri wā ra e h+ya he/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ pad+ma kā mā la ya satwaṃ/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo kāṃ ghan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shap+da pra tits+tsha swāhā/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la ya/ ma hā kā li de wī/ mahā kā la tsa turmu kha sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya sma ra si/ sa ma ya ma ti pra ma/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral/ rdo rje nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa yum chen sring mo bzhi/ las mkhan pu tra mi sring bran g.yog bka' stod 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar dam tshig bsrung /

bstan pa bskyong / dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ khyad par du yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams dang / rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe ba dang / bdag gi lam bsgrub pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs rnams kyi bsam sbyor ngan pa thams cad zhi ba'i thabs kyi 'dul bar mdzad du gsol/ gal te zhi ba'i thabs kyi 'dul du ma 'tshal na gang la gang 'tshams pa'i chad pas bcad pa dang / bskrad cing gzir ba dang / dbye ba dang / bsdigs shing dpa' bskong bar mdzad du gsol/ mdor na chos sgrub pa'i bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / bsam sbyor chos mthun yid bzhin du 'grub cing bstan pa dang / bstan pa 'dzin pa dang 'jig rten pa kun dar zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod cing thal mo gdab/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye ste/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya/ ma hā kā li di wi ye/ mahā kā la tsa turmu kha sa pa ri wā ra na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥbi sho mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thad khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ne daṃ ba l+yā di swāhā/ lan gsum/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya shā sa no pa hā ri ṇi/ e ṣa a pañci mā kā lor+dha ya i daṃ rat+na tra ya a pa ka ri ṇaṃ/ ya di t+yaṃ pra tidz+nyā/ sma ra si ta dā i daṃ duṣ+ṭan/ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ ma ra ma ra/ gṛh+na gṛh+na/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ de na mi ke na ma ra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan gcig oṃ ro ru ro ru/ bi tiṣ+ṭha ba to si ka la rak+ṣa si sa pa ri wā ra na māḥ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs lan gsum/ oṃ a li ma a li ma dzaḥdzaḥ shaṃ shaṃ li shi ded/ a shā ded/ mu smugs/ spu gri a li ma dzaḥdzaḥ nag mo sha la rub dzaḥdzaḥ oṃ ro ru ro ru tri tsa pa la a shug me ma hūm̐ ma bh+yoḥdzaḥdzaḥ i daṃ ba liṃ bhuñja kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ sarba sha trun bigh+nan mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan gsum/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ sogs gong ltar mchod/

oṃ shrī mahā kā la ya/ mahā kā li de wi ye/ mahā kā la tsa turmu khā sa pa ri wā ra oṃ ā hūm̐/ zhes pas nang mchod phul/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral/ zhing skyong dbang phyug zhal bzhi pa sogs bka' stod dam can rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang / 'jig rten du dge legs rgya chen po 'byung ba dang / bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi zhing / mthun rkyen thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod/ gtor ma'i phud yi dam chos skyong ba rnams la phul ba'i ro ma de dkar phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i gzhi bdag dbang thob cing / nang gtor za bar dbang ba rnams la 'bul dgos pas/ de'i tshul ni/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya las mdzub mo gnyis g.yab cing / bhu mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ bhu mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra a ka ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇa ad+ya nut+pan+nā twad oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes lan gsum gyi gtor ma phul/ bhu mi pa ti sa pa ri wa ra oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi nang mchod gtor la/ bod khams skyong bar byed pa'i bstan ma bcu gnyis/ gnas bdag gzhi bdag yul bdag grong bdag skor bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams la 'bul lo/ /rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i chos sgrub pa'i bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / bsam don chos bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ de nas oṃ de wa pi tsu badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ ces dang / oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces yi ge bdun ma dang / oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa'i yi ge bcu gnyis ma dang / shā sa na gong bzhin gyi rtsa sngags dang / oṃ ro ru ro ru bi tiṣ+ṭha ba dho si ka ma la rak+kha si hūm̐ bh+yoḥhūm̐/ zhes lha mo dang / oṃ ma hā kā la kā la bi kā la ra tri ta ḍom+bhi nī/ tsaṇ+ḍa li/ rak+kha si/

siṅga li/ de wi hūm̐ bh+yoḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes zhal bzhi pa gtso 'khor dang / oṃ ro ru ro ru tri tsa pa la a shug me mu hūm̐ ma bh+yoḥdzaḥdzaḥces mo'i bod pa dang / oṃ a li a li ma dza dzaḥ shaṃ shaṃ li shi ded/ a shwa ded/ mo smugs/ pu tri a li ma dzaḥdzaḥ nag mo sha la rub dzaḥdzaḥ ces las mgon pho'i bod pa ste sngags rnams lan bdun la sogs pa ci rigs bzlas la rdzogs pa dang / oṃ ma hā kā la ya/ ma hā kā li de wi/ badz+ra tsa turmu kha sa pa ri wā ra gṛh+ne daṃ ar+ghaṃ sogs nas shap+ta'i bar gyi phyi mchod/ oṃ mahā kā la sogs kyi mthar 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod phul la/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po sogs nas/ mthun rkyen thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ ces pa'i bar gyi phrin bcol gong bzhin bya/ de nas bshags pa bya ba ni/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang / mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa yum chen sring mo bzhi dang / bstan bsrung rgya mtsho'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la zhu zhing gsol ba ni/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod grogs mched 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi las dang nyon mongs pa dang / mi shes pa dang / ma gus pa dang / bag med pa dang / snyoms las kyi dbang du gyur pas rang bzhin dang bcas pas kha na ma tho ba bgyis pa dang / dam tshig ma dag pa dang / tshogs 'dres pa dang / spyod yul gcig tu gyur pa dang / bsnyen pa dang bsgrub pa la ma brtson pa dang / bsrung ma khyad par can khyed rnams dus dus su ma mchod cing / ma gsol ba'i dbang gis sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig nyams chag tu gyur pa dang / khyed rnams kyi thugs dang 'gal bar gyur pa ci mchis pa thams cad spros med rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang nas thugs rje dang mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug dpal mgon khyad par can khyed rnams kyi spyan sngar mthol lo bshags so/

/bzod par gsol/ mkha' la sprin dngas pa'am/ rgya mtsho la rlabs zhi ba ltar nongs pa spyad pa dang / de'i 'bras bu thams cad med par gyur cig zhi bar gyur cig rab tu zhi bar gyur cig sngags dang / phyag rgya dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi byin gyis rlabs pa'i mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma dar sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa 'di dang / rta mchog rgyan gyi brgyan pa 'di dang / tshogs kyi 'khor lo dam pa dang bcas pa'i mchod pa 'dis/ dpal mgon khyad par can khyed rnams kyi thugs dam bskong bar gyur cig re ba rdzogs par gyur cig de ltar gyur nas kyang bdag gi sngon gyi las las gyur pa dang / 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa'i nad gdon dang rims dang bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ dgra dang bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ tshe dang dpal dang 'byor pa dang dbang phyug phun sum tshogs par mdzad du gsol/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ khyed thugs gsang ba dam pa'i mdzod/ /dges pa chen po'i sgo che nas/ /dngos grub phrin las bdud rtsi yi/ /rgyun gyi bdag rgyud bltams par mdzod/ /dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' bstod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang / mthu stob kyi dbang phyug dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa la sogs pa dam can rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi sku'i dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags/ gsung gi༞ thugs kyi༞ sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ de nas bskang rdzas byin rlabs ni/ a mri tas bsangs/ oṃ swa bha wa shud+dho sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang drag po'i gzhal yas khang mi mgo skam po'i rtsig pa dang / rgyu ma'i drwa phyed 'phyang ba/ bse smug po'i sgo can/

steng du zhing chen gyi bla re dang / mi ro'i rgyal mtshan 'phyar ba/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du/ a las byung ba'i thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che bar/ phyi nang gsang gsum gyi dgra bgegs bkug nas bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus gsum gtor ma ri dang rgya mtsho snyam pa/ khrag gi mchod yon/ dbang po lnga'i me tog tshil chen gyi bdug spos/ zhun chen gyi mar me/ 'khris pa'i dri chab/ sha rus kyi zhal zas/ rkang gling thod rnga sogs rol mo'i bye brag gzhan yang hūm̐ mthing nag re re las byung ba'i/ bya nag rta nag g.yag nag lug nag khyi nag mi nag rnams dbang po rdzogs shing rgyan gyi brgyan pa/ stag gzig go khrab/ gos dar la sogs pa phyi nang gi dam rdzas dngos su 'byor pa dang yid kyis sprul te rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral la sogs pa dam can rgya mtsho mnyes par byed pa'i mchod pa'i sprin phung nam mkha'i khams gang bar gyur/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ ā warta ya ā brta ya hoḥ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa ṇa khaṃ swāhā/ rol cha dkrol ba'am/ dril bu sil zhing bsur chen gyi dud pa btang / g.yab dar nag pos g.yab cing / gdung ba'i dbyangs dang bcas pa'am/ med kyang rung ste/ hūm̐ rgyal ba'i kun gyi ye shes 'phrin las sku/ /gcig tu bsdus nas ma rung tshar gcod phyir/ /drag po'i skur ston rdo rje nag po che/ /dam tshig dgongs la gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /gang gi rang bzhin mkha' ltar kun khyab kyang / /drag mo'i tshul ston rdo rje nam gru ma/ /sum cu rtsa gsum de wi ko ṭa dang / /u rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gnas nas 'dir gshegs cig /byang shar ha ha rgod pa'i dur khrod du/ /zhing skyong dbang phyug chen po'i rnam 'phrul mchog /drag shul stobs ldan dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa/ /yum chen 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /dur khrod bdag po sha za yab yum dang / /gnod sbyin lcam dral las mkhan yongs kyi gtso/

/mon bu pu tra bha ṭa ral gcig ma/ /ru 'dren sde bzhi la sogs gnas 'dir gshegs/ /gzhan yang phyogs skyong zhing skyong lha klu dang / /'jigs byed gza' chen rgyu skar rgyal chen bzhi/ /snang srid lha srin dregs pa sde brgyad rnams/ /mchod gtor bzhes slad gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ bh+yoḥ che ba'i che mchog sogs/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la ya/ ma hā kā li de wi ye/ badz+ra tsa turmu kha sa pa ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ hūm̐/ mtshan nyid ldan pa'i gzhal yas dam pa 'dir/ /dam tshig can gyi rnal 'byor bdag cag rnams/ /dam rdzas mchod gtor 'dod yon sna tshogs kyis/ /thugs dam bskang phyir brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /ro bcud brgyad ldan gser skyems gtsang ma dang / /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i rak+ta'i mchod yon 'di/ /dam can rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas rnams la/ /byon skyems dam pa 'bul gyi dges par rol/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya/ ma hā ka li de wi ye badz+ra tsa turmu kha sa pa ri wa ra badz+ra a sa na tiṣ+ṭhan+tu/ pañca a mṛ ta ma hā rak+ta ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha swāhā/ de nas gong gi gtor sngags bsdus pa tshar gsum dang / phyi mchod nang mchod phul la/ phrin bcol rgyas bsdus rang gi blo la gang yod byas la/ dril bu rgyun chags su sil zhing / hūm̐/ sku dang gsung thugs rdzu 'phrul nus mthur ldan/ /bstan pa rgyas mdzad nag po chen po dang / /e ka dza ti 'dod khams dbang phyug ma/ /zhing skyong gtso 'khor dur khrod bdag po dang / /gnod sbyin yab yum pu tra lcam sring dang / /dkar mo nyi zla bdud rgyal phur bsrung sogs/ /phyi nang mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang / /rgya chen gtor ma tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang / /thugs dam nyer dgongs phyag mtshan dam pa dang / /rus rgyan drug gis 'khor los thugs dam bskang / /bdud rtsi sman dang rak+ta gsang rten lnga/ /phyi rten g.yag rog rta dang bya khyi lug /dar nag 'phan dang dgra bo'i don lnga yis/

/nag po 'khor bcas thugs dam bskong gyur cig /khyad par gri snying rgyal mtshan dag gi bskangs/ /thugs dam ma bskong bsnyen sgrub ma 'khyol dang / /mchod gtor ma 'grub nyams dang sgrib pa kun/ /nyes ltung tshogs rnams thugs rjes sbyang du gsol/ /thugs dang 'gal ba'i nyes pa ci mchis bshags/ /bstan pa bsrung dang 'gro la phan gdags phyir/ /thugs dam bskang ngo dngos grub ma lus stsol/ /bstan pa bsrung cig bsrung ma dam pa rnams/ /mgon po yi ge bcu gnyis ma dang / lha mo'i ro ru/ zhal gyi sngags thung rnams brjod la rdo rje thal mo dang / dril bu bcad bstubs su dkrol zhing / hūm̐/ sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba po/ /mgon po gri gug thod pa can/ /kha dog nag cing ro la zhon/ /nag po che la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /bh+yoḥdapal ldan lha mo re ba ti/ /srid pa gsum la dbang bsgyur zhing / /'dod khams mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo'i mchog /dus mtshan nag mo khyod la bstod/ /hūm̐/ dpal ldan srid gsum dbang bsgyur ba/ /nag po chen po mi bzad gtsigs/ /mchu 'phyang shugs che byis pa'i gzugs/ /drag po'i sgra sgrogs khyod la bstod/ /nag po gnod sbyin yab yum dang / /pu tra bha ṭa ral gcig ma/ /ru 'dren sde bzhi la sogs pa'i/ /bstan bsrung 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ /dam rdzas mchod gtor 'di bzhes las/ /thub pa'i bstan pa dar ba dang / /bstan 'dzin sku tshe rab brtan zhing / /'jig rten bde zhing skyid par mdzod/ /khyad par rnal 'byor bdag cag gi /mi mthun bar chad zhi ba dang / /tshe dang bsod nams rab rgyas te/ /bsam pa'i don rnams 'grub par mdzod/ /ces bstod cing 'phrin las gzhol la/ gong gi bskang rdzas bshos bu bzhi po/ chang phud dpal 'bar dang bcas steng du phul la/ hūm̐ bh+yoḥdapal ldan mgon po ma hā kā la dang / /dpal ldan lha mo mi pham srid gsum bdag /rdo rje nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa/ /ma rung las mdzad yum chen sring mo bzhi/

/lcam dral khyed kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba'i/ /dur khrod bdag po zhing skyong 'khor dang bcas/ /snang srid lha srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas/ /dregs pa pho rgyud༞ /mkha' lding ce spyang bya khyi༞ /pu tra la sogs las mkhan༞ /ye shes mgon po dkar bdud༞ /bsrung ma dam can rgya mtsho tshogs dang bcas/ /'dir bzhugs gzhi bdag gnyan po 'khor dang bcas/ /'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma༞ /'dzam bu tri ka'i zhal zas༞ /sman raka phud kyi mchod pa 'di bzhes shig /sngar bcol legs pa'i gtang rag gnyan por 'bul/ /da bcol legs pa'i gsal 'debs gnyan po bzhes/ /dpon slob bsrung zhing rkyen rnams zlog pa dang / /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs la sogs/ /bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnam mang po/ /thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /bstan pa rgyas pa'i las 'di myur du bsgrub/ /bla mas bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /ces brjod la/ gtor sngags rnams bzlas shing / zhi drag gi 'phrin las gang 'dod pa bcol/ gtor ma steng gi sa gtsang sar phul bas mgron rnams tshim ste dges bzhin du rang gnas su gshegs par bsam/ de nas/ hūm̐ srid zhi dpal 'byor ma lus 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /thub pa'i bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang / /de 'dzin byed pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams/ /dpal 'byor gyis rgyan yun ring zhabs brtan mdzod/ /khyad par rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob la/ /tshe ring nad med bde skyid phun sum tshogs/ /bsam pa'i don rnams yid bzhin 'grub pa dang / /'gro ba'i don la mthu dang ldan par mdzod/ /dpal mgon ma hā kā la'i gzi brjid dang / /lha chen nag po gdong bzhi'i mthu rtsal dang / /las mgon pho nya rnams kyi 'phrin las kyi/ /gnas mchog 'dir yang bkra shis deng 'dir stsol/ /zhes brjod la/ yi ge brgya pa tshar gsum gyi lhag chad kha bskang / ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang /

/gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyis stsal bar/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /ces brjod/ rten yod na phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag du yang sku gzugs kyi rten 'di rnams la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams ji srid 'byung ba bzhis gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi mgon dang skyabs dang dpung gnyen dam pa mdzad du gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+tha badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhes brjod cing rten la me tog gtor/ mgon po lha brgyad kyi rten med na gshegs gsol mi nyan pas mdun du bskyed pa'i lha brgyad rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim zhes brjod/ gzhan rten med pa rnams la/ oṃ khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ badz+ra muḥzhes dang / mtheb srin gyi se gol byas la/ rten la ma brten pa'i gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa rnams gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams rang la gnyis su med par thim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang gi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas bsrung ba byas la/ dge ba 'di yi nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i/ /lus can kun gyi bsod nams ye shes tshogs/ /myur du bsgrub ste tshe 'di kho na la/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la 'god par shog /ces pas dge ba bsngo/ hūm̐ 'jigs rung dus mtha'i sprin ltar nag pa'i sku/ /hūm̐ phaṭa nga ro 'brug stong ldir ba'i gsung /

/spros pa nyer zhi mkha' dbyings chen po'i thugs/ /dpal ldan ma hā kā la bkra shis shog /gang gi mthu yi brgya byin wa ltar zhum/ /ming tsam thos pas nad do cog las skyobs/ /mtshan mo khams gsum myul ba rdzu 'phrul can/ /ma gcig srid gsum bdag mo'i bkra shis shog /dpa' brjid mi sdug mthing nag rngam pa'i zhal/ /ral pa dmar ser dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar/ /ljags kyi dbang po glog ltar 'khrug pa can/ /zhing skyong gdong pa bzhi pa'i bkra shig shog /sprul pa bye bas sa gsum khyab par 'gengs/ /bdud dpung tshar gcod bsgrub la dngos grub stsol/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin bu bzhin skyong mdzad pa/ /pho nya las mkhan rnams kyi bkra shis shog /ces bkra shis rgyas par bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di ni sa skya pa'i yi dam bka' bsrung rnams la gtor ma 'bul ba'i tshul nyung la don tshang ba'i sa lo'i phyag len gyi rim pa ji lta ba bzhin legs par bkod de/ lha rigs tshe dbang rdo rje can gyi thugs dam bskul mar/ sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen gyis/ dbu rtse pho brang du bris nas phul ba yin pa thugs dam gyi nyams bzhes chu bo'i rgyun bzhin 'chag med yod pa zhig mdzad pa 'tshal dge'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 8 sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen/ sa skya'i bka' srung rnams kyi gtor chog rgyun gyi nyams len/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 9
